children: Hines Global reported an NAV per share/OP Unit of $9.83 as of August 31, 2026 and set a September distribution of $0.052 per share.
August 31, 2026 NAV totaled $3,345,788k, equating to $9.83 per share/OP Unit (unchanged from July 31 per-share figure).
Portfolio valued at $6,886,628k in real estate, 56 properties, 94% leased, ~26.2M sq ft; leverage ~30%.
September 2026 gross distribution set at $0.052 per share; net varies by class (up to $0.052 net for I/AX/JX).
Transaction price for October 1 equals August 31 NAV; reinvestment and redemption prices tied to that transaction price.
Acquired Castings Commerce Center (862k sf, 96% leased) for ~$117.0M; valuations reviewed by Altus Group U.S. Inc.
